aboutPage.headline: Founder of the Academia do Poder — investigating the new relationships between power, identity and leadership in contemporary life.
aboutPage.p1: Andrea Eboli is a researcher, author, professor and founder of the Academia do Poder. She investigates the new relationships between power, identity and leadership in contemporary life.
aboutPage.p2: Her investigation begins with two central questions: why do people who have power seem to lose it when they leave roles, titles or positions? And why do so many others, even surrounded by recognition, influence and performance, not feel truly powerful?
aboutPage.p3: With international master's and doctoral training, an academic career and more than two decades of executive experience, Andrea proposes a new reading of contemporary power and conscious leadership.
aboutPage.p4: Creator of the Conscious Structure of Power — ECP, her original method, she turns this investigation into a practical path for people and leaders to cross the distance between having power and feeling truly potent in it.
aboutPage.quote: The world has changed. So have the relationships of power. And the way we occupy, sustain and live power must change with it.

serPoderPage.headline: The distance between having power and feeling truly potent in it.
serPoderPage.introBody: Ser Poder is a new reading of contemporary power and conscious leadership. It begins with a simple, uncomfortable realization: having power and feeling powerful are not the same thing. Roles, titles and recognition do not guarantee a sense of potency — and it is in that distance that most people get lost.
serPoderPage.q1: Why do people who have power seem to lose it when they leave roles, titles or positions?
serPoderPage.q2: Why do so many others, even surrounded by recognition, influence and performance, not feel truly powerful?
serPoderPage.ecpBody: The ECP is Andrea Eboli's original method — a practical path to cross that distance. Instead of treating power as a role or a performance, it works power as a conscious structure: something you occupy, sustain and live from the inside out. It is the axis that connects every concept in this hub.
